empty: Column names are not available yet. Keep automatic mode or inherit the dataset settings; no headers will be guessed.
datasetHint: Dataset defaults apply to files without an upload override. Existing file overrides remain independent. Reparse files to apply changes.
uploadHint: Each file can inherit dataset defaults or keep its own column roles. Header preview supports UTF-8 CSV; without a preview, enter exact column names manually.
headerFailed: Headers are unavailable or ambiguous. Inherit dataset settings, use automatic mode, or enter known column names manually.
invalidStored: This historical table configuration cannot be edited with these controls. Review advanced JSON to correct it.
documentTableHint: Table column defaults are managed in dataset settings. File-specific overrides are set during upload; this document editor preserves them.
graphExecutionHint: Blank fields retain existing values or server defaults. Phase timeout 0 disables that timeout; lock wait 0 uses 600 seconds. Attempt counts include the first execution.
raptorHint: Advanced JSON supports RAPTOR scope (file/dataset), clustering_method (gmm/ahc), tree_builder (raptor/psi) and ext budgets. Title chunking is configured in a parsing pipeline.
overlapHint: Use 0–90%. Legacy stored fractions below 1 are displayed as percentages.
manualDefaultsHint: Columns without an explicit role use the service default. An empty role list is valid.
manualNamesHint: Enter column names exactly as they appear in the file, including dots and surrounding spaces. Names are not inferred or checked against the file.
columnBlank: Column names cannot be empty or whitespace only.
columnDuplicate: This exact column name has already been added.
columnDraftHint: This name takes effect only after you click Add column.
